description: This Java class 'ReportService' provides methods for generating PDF and CSV reports related to employees and their performance metrics. It interacts with repositories to fetch data, formats it using PDFBox for PDFs and OpenCSV for CSVs, and exposes public methods for report generation.

classes.name: ReportService
classes.description: A service class annotated with @Service that provides methods to generate employee reports in PDF and CSV formats, utilizing repositories and third-party libraries to create formatted reports.

methods.name: generateEmployeesPdf
methods.description: Generates a PDF report listing all employees, sorted by full name, using PDFBox library, and returns the PDF as a byte array.

methods.name: generateEmployeePdf
methods.description: Generates a detailed PDF report for a specific employee, including performance metrics sorted by timestamp, using PDFBox library, returns the report as a byte array.

methods.name: generateMetricsCsv
methods.description: Creates a CSV file listing all performance metrics sorted by timestamp, using OpenCSV, and returns it as a byte array.
